newsitem.title: USA: JPE sees Q3, 1996 results below year-ago.
newsitem.headline: JPE sees Q3, 1996 results below year-ago.

text.p: JPE Inc said it expects its results for the third quarter and full 1996 year to be somewhat below results for the comparable periods of 1995.

In a statement, the company said it expects higher sales for the third quarter and the full year, but a change in the product mix and production inefficiencies caused by significant unit volume increases at JPE's fastener operation will reduce the company's overall earnings.

In the third quarter of 1995, JPE, a holding company with auto and truck parts manufacturing and distribution operations, earned $880,000, or $0.22 a share, on sales of $44.9 million. For the full 1995 year, JPE earned $4.45 million, or $1.09 a share, on sales of $169.2 million.

"Although we are disappointed with the estimated third quarter results, we have identified the causes of our operating difficulties and have put plans in place to correct them," JPE Chairman John Psarouthakis said. "I am pleased with the results of our other operations and look forward to seeing the benefits of improvements we have been implementing."
